description.value: When using Personal Teleporter, you may place the portal that would normally appear within 5 feet of you anywhere within range that you can see instead. If a Huge or smaller creature or a Medium or smaller unsecured object occupies that space, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your tech save DC (objects automatically fail, and creatures may choose to fail). On a failure, a Medium or smaller creature or object drops through the portal, appearing prone within 5 feet of the linked portal; a Large or Huge creature instead simply falls prone in place.
